name: Hina Javed
headline: Data analyst: SQL, BI dashboards and experiment analysis

items.title: CV: Hina Javed
items.text: Data analyst with 3 years of experience turning messy business data into dashboards and decisions. Strong SQL and Python (pandas). Power BI with DAX, some Tableau. Modelling with dbt. Statistics background: hypothesis tests, A/B testing, cohort analysis.

items.title: Power BI sales dashboard for a retail chain
items.text: Built a Power BI sales dashboard for a 40-store retail chain. Star-schema model in SQL Server, DAX measures for like-for-like growth and margin, row-level security per region. Replaced 12 weekly Excel reports; managers now check it daily.

items.title: Marketing data models with dbt and Snowflake
items.text: Rebuilt a marketing agency's reporting layer as dbt models on Snowflake: staging, intermediate and mart layers with tests on every key. Channel spend and conversions now reconcile to the cent; report build time fell from 3 hours to 12 minutes.

items.title: A/B test analysis for an e-commerce checkout
items.text: Analysed a checkout redesign test with 48k sessions. Checked sample-ratio mismatch first, then a two-proportion z-test and a 95% confidence interval. The new design lifted conversion by 2.1 points (p = 0.01). Wrote a one-page decision memo the founders could read in two minutes.

items.title: Cleaning and automating messy Excel reports
items.text: A manufacturer had 30 inconsistent Excel files from different plants. Wrote a pandas script that cleans, merges and validates them into one tidy workbook every Monday, with a log of rejected rows. Saved the finance team a full day each week.

items.title: sql-cohort-analysis (GitHub README)
items.text: sql-cohort-analysis: SQL templates for monthly retention cohorts, plus a notebook that draws the retention triangle.
